findings.title: REQ-TRIAGE-004 defines no measurable latency or timeout bound
findings.rationale: REQ-TRIAGE-004 states 'The service must respond quickly.' The source document itself records: 'No numeric latency or timeout bound is defined by this source.' Because no measurable criterion exists, it is not possible to determine whether REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 3 satisfies or violates the requirement. The requirement is materially ambiguous. Under DR-002 and advisory_resolution, material ambiguity is independently sufficient for ABSTAIN. Under DR-011, SPEC_AMBIGUITY carries severity NONE.

source_anchors.excerpt: Statement: The service must respond quickly. Note: No numeric latency or timeout bound is defined by this source.

findings.suggested_human_check: Define a measurable latency or timeout bound in SRC-TRIAGE-004-PRD before attempting verification. Until a numeric criterion is established, compliance cannot be determined.
